what: the card design driven by a real Linux driver in a QEMU VM

setup.algorithm_in_model: SHA-256(challenge || nonce_le), a stand-in for the card's Argon2id/HashX
setup.driver: card/linux/anubis_pci.c, polled (no MSI), self-test in probe
setup.vm: -M q35 -m 512 -no-reboot, host kernel, busybox initramfs, driver insmod'ed

reproduce: ./card/tools/qemu_card_test.sh  (first run builds QEMU, ~10 min on 56 cores; later runs ~10 s)
caveats: the device model runs SHA-256, not the card's Argon2id or HashX - this tests the register protocol
the driver polls; a real card would raise an MSI on done
a real FPGA still has to match bar size, enumeration timing and the PCIe IP's quirks
